newsitem.title: FRANCE: Jospin expected to be appointed premier Monday.
newsitem.headline: Jospin expected to be appointed premier Monday.

text.p: French Prime Minister Alain Juppe will tender his resignation to President Jacques Chirac on Monday morning following Sunday's election defeat and Socialist leader Lionel Jospin should be appointed to succeed him immediately, government sources said.
They said Juppe and Jospin would have a formal handover at the prime minister's Matignon office on Monday afternoon.
